findings.detail: Criticality 7/10. The recursive prompt fixture checks only that a nested diff command appears, while existing historical-guidance tests use a single repository. No fixture supplies distinct historical child instructions. Consequently, the current root-only guide lookup silently omits module/AGENTS.md while every prompt assertion passes, allowing review without mandatory child checks.
findings.fix: Add child and nested historical-guide fixtures that assert inclusion from the trusted parent gitlink revision and exclusion of changed checkout instructions, alongside the guide-resolution fix.
findings.title: write-scrut-tests: Structured output checks omit historical child guidance.

findings.detail: Criticality 7/10. The contract assertion tests changed membership in --after, but always supplies statuses with matching membership_paths. No negative case exercises the new status-membership rejection. Removing that guard would leave these assertions satisfied while permitting a successful status from another scope to authorize simplification.
findings.fix: Keep scopes, snapshots and results unchanged, alter only a successful status's membership_paths, and assert that the gate rejects it with the status-membership mismatch reason. Also cover a missing membership_paths field.
findings.title: write-scrut-tests: Structured output checks lack status-membership rejection coverage.

strengths: Fixtures connect stored digest membership to prompts, validation, change reporting, gates and symlink discovery.
Coverage includes nested edits, staged content with restored disk bytes, exact gitlink membership and unrelated-file rejection.
Deterministic mutation and write-failure fixtures require unsuccessful exit and empty output.
Existing integration tests cover index preservation, reviewer failures, concurrent aspects and cancellation.
summary: Reviewed the complete specified committed scope and mapped changed behavior to added and existing tests. Coverage is broad, with two important gaps in historical child guidance and status-membership rejection. Suites were not executed because their fixtures create and remove files.
